项目入口：不需要 AI Agent 的项目自助菜单与命令。\n\n age:
Project entry: a self-service project menu and commands that need no AI Agent.

    agenthelm project                  interactive menu (in a terminal); without a terminal it prints the overview and exits without waiting for input
    agenthelm project find <words…>     find files: keywords, dates (2025-12, October), --type, --in; --open N opens item N
    agenthelm project open <path>       open a file (--reveal shows its directory, --copy copies the path)
    agenthelm project refs <path>       who references it / what it references
    agenthelm project progress [words]  see progress: grouped by status; --status shows one group, --all includes finished items
    agenthelm project show <item>       item details: the ID, an old ID, an alias or a fragment of the title all work
    agenthelm project guide            project guide
    agenthelm project health           check the project and environment (including whether the scaffold matches the latest version); exit code 1 when something must be handled
    agenthelm project fix [items…]      fix and update: preview by default, --apply runs it; --keep / --accept choose for customized files
    agenthelm project fix add-skeleton [paths…]   add missing skeleton files from the template (existing files are left alone)
    agenthelm project fix profile [fields…]       change only the chosen Profile fields; the preview has a diff
    agenthelm project fix --skip <ID> --reason …  skip a finding permanently (recorded in the decisions file synced with the project); --unskip <ID> withdraws it
    agenthelm project record <item|new> record an item: preview by default, --apply writes
    agenthelm project tools [tool]      tools the project declares itself; --run --apply runs one
    agenthelm project capabilities     whether each capability is available right now, and why

The launcher in the project root (./menu by default) is the same as agenthelm project --project <project root>.
Global options can go anywhere: --project <directory>, --output text|json, --no-input, --offline.
--demo study|personal|research|blank tries a built-in fictional project; add --demo-fault
index-broken|offline|runtime-old|conflict; demo results are all marked as demo and read or write no real files.

Exit codes: 0 success; 1 no result or something must be handled; 2 usage error (including --skip of a finding ID that does not exist now);
3 the runtime is incompatible with the project entry; 4 a capability is unavailable (including a damaged decisions file); 5 write conflict (someone just changed it,
including a decisions file just updated from another machine); 6 execution failed; 130 interrupted.
Scaffold differences count only as "suggested" and never make the health exit code 1.
wf：人用的文件查找入口，基于交付物台账（runtime/assets.py），:
wf: a file-finding entry for people, built on the deliverable ledger (runtime/assets.py); no Agent needed.

    wf                       interactive mode
    wf notes Sept 1           search directly (dates and synonyms are recognized automatically)
    wf -o notes Sept 1        search, then open the newest result right away
    wf recent                deliverables changed recently
    wf cases [words]         Case list (active first)
    wf refs <path|number> [levels]  who references it / what it references
    wf o|f|c|p|v <number>     open / show in the file manager / copy the path / print the path / list versions (the number refers to the last result)
    wf check                 ledger audit summary
    wf rebuild               force a ledger rebuild

--project <directory> and --output json can go anywhere; by default the Project Profile is searched upward from the current directory.
Opening, showing and copying call system commands only on macOS; other platforms print the absolute path.
